title: PHP 8.3.36 Released!
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 8.3.36. This is a security release fixing two critical vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution. All PHP 8.3 users are strongly encouraged to update immediately.

There are no complete mitigations, updating is the only safe choice. See the for details. security advisory

For source downloads of PHP 8.3.36 please visit our , Windows source and binaries can also be found . The list of changes is recorded in the . downloads pagethereChangeLog
